panels.title: Station (PS)
panels.description: Programme Service name most recently assembled (last 1h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMaxIf(ps, timestamp, ps != '') AS station FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: PI Code
panels.description: Programme Identification (hex) of the most recent group

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('0x', upper(hex(argMax(pi_code, timestamp)))) AS pi FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: PTY
panels.description: Programme Type code of the most recent group

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(pty, timestamp) AS pty FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: TP / TA
panels.description: Traffic Programme / Traffic Announcement flags (most recent group)

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(argMax(tp, timestamp)), ' / ', toString(argMax(ta, timestamp))) AS tp_ta FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
SELECT argMaxIf(radiotext, timestamp, radiotext != '') AS radiotext FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Stations Seen
panels.description: Latest known state per PI code (rds.station_latest)

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('0x', upper(hex(pi_code))) AS pi, ps, freq_hz / 1e6 AS freq_mhz, pty, tp, ta, radiotext, last_seen, group_count FROM rds.station_latest FINAL ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Groups / min by Type
panels.description: Decoded RDS groups per minute, split by group type

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, group_type AS metric, count() AS groups FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time, group_type ORDER BY time

panels.title: Avg Block Errors
panels.description: Average CRC-failed blocks per emitted group (pipe-health signal)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, avg(block_errors) AS avg_block_errors FROM rds.messages WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
